description: He wears a deep blue textured knee-length tunic with narrow gold geometric woven trim at its neck, central front, cuffs and hem. A cream underlayer shows at the neck and wrists. A brown wool-like shoulder wrap is fastened by paired circular gold-toned brooches connected across the upper chest. His brown leather-looking belt has a buckle, round ornament and long decorated hanging end. Brown trousers are gathered above dark striped or wrapped calf coverings, with low brown closed shoes. The clothing is substantial and opaque, with restrained woven decoration and visible natural textile texture; exact fibers are not confirmed. No headgear or weapon is present.
